ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit exfil via ntdsutil 'create full' / IFM on domain controllers
ucs.description: Hunts for the ntdsutil.exe 'create full' / 'ifm' / 'activate instance ntds' command pattern Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) uses on compromised DCs to stage a full Active Directory database backup for offline credential cracking. Behaviour was specifically called out in CISA AA24-038A and the FBI/NSA Five Eyes advisory on CCP pre-positioning in US critical infrastructure.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_name) as process_name values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.dest) as dest from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe OR Processes.process="*ntdsutil*") by Processes.process_id Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process, "(?i)(create\s+full|ac\s+i\s+ntds|\sifm\s|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)") | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name parent_process_name process
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon (G1017 / VOLTZITE / Vanguard Panda) — ntdsutil NTDS.dit IFM theft on DCs
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" or ProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create full", "ac i ntds", " ifm ", "activate instance ntds")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"   // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandparentFile = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon — ntdsutil NTDS.dit IFM theft on DCs (Sentinel via 4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe" or CommandLine has "ntdsutil"
| where CommandLine has_any ("create full", "ac i ntds", " ifm ", "activate instance ntds")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Theft via ntdsutil IFM
id: 4f9b8a30-6d12-4a5e-b9af-1a3c9f7d2e10
status: experimental
description: Detects ntdsutil being used to create a full backup of NTDS.dit (IFM media), a Volt Typhoon (VOLTZITE / Vanguard Panda) signature TTP per CISA AA24-038A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'create full'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - ' ifm '
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_image or selection_cmd) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised AD backup / disaster-recovery rehearsal (should be infrequent, change-managed)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 (@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\\Ntdsutil.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*ntdsutil* OR *NTDSUTIL*)) @CommandLine:(*"create full"* OR *"create Full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"AC I NTDS"* OR *" ifm "* OR *" IFM "* OR *"activate instance ntds"* OR *"Activate Instance NTDS"*) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/ntdsutil/i
| CommandLine=/(create\s+full|ac\s+i\s+ntds|\sifm\s|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=([count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])]))
ucs.rationale: ntdsutil 'create full' / 'ifm' is the specific NTDS.dit dump path CISA, NSA and Microsoft attributed to Volt Typhoon's DC compromise playbook (vs. dcsync / esentutl / vssadmin variants used by other crews). It executes on domain controllers only, by interactive admin sessions — false-positive surface is restricted to scheduled AD backups, which are change-managed.

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon offline-cred staging: reg.exe SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hive save → archive staging
ucs.description: Hunts the Volt Typhoon LOTL pattern of using built-in reg.exe to save HKLM\SAM, HKLM\SYSTEM and HKLM\SECURITY hives (for offline SAM/LSA secrets extraction), typically staged to C:\Windows\Temp or C:\Users\Public and then archived. This sequence is highlighted across CISA AA24-038A, Microsoft (Volt Typhoon) and CrowdStrike (VANGUARD PANDA) reporting and is preferred by the actor over LSASS dumping because it leaves a smaller AV footprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.dest) as dest from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=reg.exe Processes.process="*save*" by Processes.process_id Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process, "(?i)\bsave\b") AND match(process, "(?i)hklm[\\\\ ]+(sam|system|security)\b") | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon — reg save HKLM\SAM|SYSTEM|SECURITY for offline cred extraction
let HiveSave = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "reg.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has " save "
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)hklm[\\ ]+(sam|system|security)\b"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              GrandparentFile = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              HiveOutPath = extract(@"(?i)hklm[\\ ]+(?:sam|system|security)\s+([^\s\"]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine);
HiveSave
| where isnotempty(HiveOutPath)
| extend SuspiciousStaging = HiveOutPath has_any (@"\windows\temp", @"\users\public", @"\programdata", @"\perflogs", @"\$recycle.bin")
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon — reg save HKLM\SAM|SYSTEM|SECURITY (Sentinel via 4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\reg.exe"
| where CommandLine has " save "
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)hklm[\\ ]+(sam|system|security)\b"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend HiveOutPath = extract(@"(?i)hklm[\\ ]+(?:sam|system|security)\s+([^\s\"]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend SuspiciousStaging = HiveOutPath has_any (@"\windows\temp", @"\users\public", @"\programdata", @"\perflogs")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, HiveOutPath, SuspiciousStaging
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon Registry Hive Theft via reg.exe save
id: 8c1e6d92-31b5-4a8e-9d1a-2f7e0b4d8c45
status: experimental
description: Detects reg.exe being used to save HKLM\SAM, HKLM\SYSTEM or HKLM\SECURITY hives — the LOTL credential-staging step attributed to Volt Typhoon / VOLTZITE in CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft's Volt Typhoon advisory.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/05/24/volt-typhoon-targets-us-critical-infrastructure-with-living-off-the-land-techniques/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
  selection_save:
    CommandLine|contains: ' save '
  selection_hive:
    CommandLine|re|i: 'hklm[\\ ]+(sam|system|security)\b'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_save and selection_hive and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned backup tooling that shells out to reg.exe (rare in modern estates)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.002
  - attack.t1003.004
  - attack.g1017
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @Image:(*\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE OR *\\Reg.exe) @CommandLine:(*" save "* OR *" Save "* OR *" SAVE "*) @CommandLine:(*hklm\\sam* OR *HKLM\\SAM* OR *hklm\\system* OR *HKLM\\SYSTEM* OR *hklm\\security* OR *HKLM\\SECURITY* OR *"hklm sam"* OR *"HKLM SAM"* OR *"hklm system"* OR *"HKLM SYSTEM"* OR *"hklm security"* OR *"HKLM SECURITY"*) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\reg\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/\s+save\s+/i
| CommandLine=/hklm[\\\s]+(sam|system|security)\b/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| HiveOutPath := regex("(?i)hklm[\\\\\\s]+(?:sam|system|security)\\s+(?<path>[^\"\\s]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=([count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine])]))
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon explicitly avoids dropping tooling (mimikatz, secretsdump) — CISA and Microsoft both single out reg-save-of-SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY as a LOTL signature for this actor and aligned PRC clusters. The triple-hive pattern (SAM for local NT hashes, SECURITY for LSA secrets / cached creds, SYSTEM for boot key) under one user session is virtually unheard-of outside red team / IR rehearsal, giving
